narratives.Description: rfc(harness): host-grokbot adapter + Grok Bot–native consumer façade
narratives.Overview:
## Parent

Set-level bind: [5556011390](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4201#issuecomment-5556011390) / successor lean [5555943410](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4201#issuecomment-5555943410). Companion recut: #4202.

## Recut (post-bind, 2026-09-06)

Locked from the set arc. Grok Bot is not Grok Build. This issue is the host adapter plus consumer facade. The arc thin router lives on #4202, not here.

## Summary

Add a first-class Grok Bot host adapter and thin consumer facade so Directive skills (especially swarm) run natively on Grok Bot -- not as a Warp/Cursor dialect pasted into chat.

Directive stays a repo practice layer (standards + xBRIEF + gates). Grok Bot stays the coding host / CoS cockpit. This RFC is the host-deposit boundary, not a bid to own Slack/calendar/bot roster orchestration.

## Presumption

A dedicated `grok-bot` platform descriptor and `host-grokbot.md` are required. Extending `host-grok-build.md` is not enough if probe 6 (`spawn_subagent` -> `grok-build`) fires first.

## Proposed shape

### 1. Detect before spawn_subagent

Add descriptor `grok-bot` mapping to widgets for operator gates and Task/executor/CloudAgent for workers.

- Name unique grok-bot signals (widgets, Task/executor, cloud agents, routines, short main-chat beats).
- Probe those signals **before** probe 6 (`spawn_subagent` -> `grok-build`). Same class as Claude-before-Task (#3134) and OpenClaw-before-grok-build (#2875).
- Do not misclassify as grok-build via bare spawn_subagent, or as cursor-composer via bare Task.

Map: Phase 0 / mid-scope / dual-stop -> question widgets (Discuss and Back visible, #1470 / #1563); leaf workers -> executor/CloudAgent with worktree isolation MUST before parallel spawn; parent consolidate -> short main-chat beats; human decision -> one clear ask then stop.

### 2. Consumer facade: three verbs for swarm

Expose propose cohort / launch / status. Keep Phases 0-6 internal. Lazy-load phase refs; do not load all host adapters just in case (#2928).

### 3. Thin skill pack for Grok Bot consumers

Small discovery set: setup, xbrief, triage, swarm (facade), build -- thin routers. The **arc** thin router is #4202. This pack list points at #4202. Do not implement that skill twice.

### 4. Doctor / cold-start chat narratable

One happy path: npx @deftai/directive doctor -> one next step -> optional agent-driven setup. Hide package-manager and offline forks behind doctor.

### 5. Prefer connector-shaped GitHub where the host has it

Prefer GitHub MCP/connector tools when available; gh as fallback.

## Non-goals

- Do not replace other hosts.
- Do not make Grok Bot a multi-agent app orchestrator inside Directive.
- No auto-dispatch arcs without operator consent (#3578 / #1702).
- Do not drop worktree isolation for parallel code cohorts.
- Do not implement the design-critique thin skill on this issue.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `grok-bot` descriptor plus misclassification tests: unique signals before spawn_subagent.
- [ ] `host-grokbot.md`.
- [ ] propose/launch/status docs.
- [ ] Consumer skill-pack slice points at #4202 for arc; no second arc router here.
- [ ] Doctor one-liner; CATEGORY.md note.
- [ ] No normative contract bodies in thin routers.
- [ ] Widgets used for Phase 0 gates preserve numbered Discuss and Back.
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry.

## Practical sequence

1. Detect + host-grokbot.md + widget contract (Discuss/Back).
2. Swarm facade.
3. Consumer pack + doctor (arc router deferred to #4202).
4. GitHub connector preference.

Refs: deft-directive-swarm SKILL.md #2928; #1355; #1331; #3134; #2875; #1470; #1563; docs/CATEGORY.md; #4202; #3845.

## Current-state validity (read, not re-invented)

- Swarm route table at this SHA has warp, cursor, claude-code, openclaw, grok-build, generic-terminal. No `host-grokbot.md`. No `grok-bot` descriptor.
- Probe 6 is `spawn_subagent` -> `grok-build` (deft-directive-swarm SKILL Runtime Capability Detection). Grok Bot is not in that list.
- Design-critique skill triggers are design critique / design-critique / critique panel / mechanism-shaped triage. #3845 is open: literal "run an arc" does not route.
- `parseOperatorRunPosture` (#4072) already matches direct / github-only / no worktrees. Direct default on grok-bot detect is host wiring, not a new posture parser.
- Deterministic questions (#1470) require numbered menus with Discuss and Back unless the host UI visibly preserves those labels.
- Companion comments: 5547685066 on #4201, 5547685199 on #4202.

## Stop 2

charter: open critique. Neither issue names a refutation-target field. The portfolio claim is still the target.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-06T00:59:41Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Dispatch SHA: `20f9dfbda67746fc0367b4856cfeb016e6e96213`
Ceiling: 5555932274. Charter: open critique. Target shape: set-level. Portfolio #4201 / #4202. Anchor #4201.

Verdict on the portfolio claim: **the split is real and they compose only if detect is ordered**. Grok Bot is not Grok Build. There is no `grok-bot` descriptor and no `host-grokbot.md`. #3845 is still open. Extending `host-grok-build.md` does not fix misclassification if probe 6 fires first.

## `blocks-the-design` -- grok-bot detect must precede spawn_subagent or it never fires

Evidence. Swarm SKILL Runtime Capability Detection at this SHA: probe 6 is `spawn_subagent` -> descriptor `grok-build`. Route table has no `grok-bot`. Claude/OpenClaw already have unique-signal-before-fallback rules (#3134 / #2875) for this class. #4201 says do not misclassify as grok-build via bare spawn_subagent, but it does not name probe order.

Concrete failure mode. Grok Bot that also exposes `spawn_subagent` (or a Task-like tool) classifies as `grok-build` or `cursor-composer`. #4202 "on grok-bot detect, default arc-mode:direct" never runs. Widgets never map. The dedicated adapter is dead code.

Disposition consequence. #4201 AC must name unique grok-bot signals and a probe slot **before** probe 6. Same pattern as Claude-before-Task. Without that, #4202 direct-default is unsatisfiable.

## `sharpens-framing` -- #4202 trigger close is host-neutral; widget/direct-default is not

Evidence. Design-critique skill triggers at this SHA: design critique, design-critique, critique panel, mechanism-shaped triage. #3845 open: literal "run an arc" does not route. `parseOperatorRunPosture` already matches direct / github-only. Widget mapping is grok-bot-specific. #1470 / #1563: host widgets MUST still show numbered Discuss and Back.

Concrete failure mode. Burying #3845 inside a grok-bot-only issue delays a host-neutral miss. Shipping #4202 widgets without #1470 Discuss/Back is a contract miss on every Phase-0 gate.

Disposition consequence. Keep #4202, but split AC: (1) trigger fixtures close #3845 with no grok-bot dependency; (2) widget map + direct default depend on #4201 detect and MUST preserve Discuss/Back. Record #4202 as status:child of #4201 for (2), not for (1).

## `sharpens-framing` -- Consumer pack "arc (router)" on #4201 duplicates #4202

Evidence. #4201 proposal 3 lists thin routers: setup, xbrief, triage, arc (router), swarm (facade), build. #4202 is that arc router. Two issues both claim the thin skill.

Concrete failure mode. Two PRs edit the same pack slice and diverge. Or #4201 ships an empty arc router and #4202 is treated as optional.

Disposition consequence. #4201 pack list points at #4202 for the arc router. Do not implement the arc thin skill twice.

## `footnote` -- parseOperatorRunPosture already exists

#4202 should consume #4072, not re-parse direct/checkout. Host default is "if grok-bot and no checkout token, treat as direct" -- one line in the adapter, not a second parser.

## Injection / swarm lens

Thin routers that trigger on "phrases humans say" are untrusted input. Keep normative contract bodies out (already a non-goal). Worktree isolation before parallel code cohorts stays MUST (already a non-goal to drop). Widgets that omit Discuss/Back become an un-escapable consent UI.

## Road not taken

Merge #4201 and #4202 into one issue -- worse for swarm, hides the #3845 split. Extend only host-grok-build.md -- fails the probe-order hole.

## Steelman

Steelman for "Grok Bot is close enough to Grok Build; add a subsection": both are xAI, spawn_subagent may exist, one adapter is cheaper. That flips the dedicated-descriptor finding only if unique grok-bot signals do not exist. The filing names widgets, Task/executor, cloud agents, routines, short main-chat beats. Those are not spawn_subagent. The steelman does not survive that inventory.
